verdict.rationale:
Persona's Workflows feature is explicitly a rules/automation engine that lets users automate repetitive manual decisions and decrease review time, triggered by identity verification events, and Webhooks notify external services on any Persona resource event, enabling event-driven automation chains. Reports can also be configured to run automatically at intervals, reinforcing rule-based automation.

missing for 10: detailed documentation of the workflow rule-builder UI/conditional logic syntax, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
